usageNotes: Permanently removes a named IP/network alias from a VM's firewall alias set; any firewall rules on that VM that reference this alias by name will break silently after deletion, so audit dependent rules first. The operation returns null synchronously — there is no UPID to poll. Requires VM.Config.Network on the VM's path.

examples.summary: Delete the 'mgmt-net' alias from VM 200 on node pve1

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named firewall alias; any VM firewall rules referencing this alias by name will no longer resolve, potentially breaking intended traffic policies without immediate error.
tips: Pass the current config digest to guard against concurrent modifications — fetch it from the GET aliases list before deleting.
Check for rules referencing the alias name before deletion: use the VM firewall rules list endpoint and grep for the alias name.
This is VM-scoped; a same-named alias at the datacenter or node level is a separate object and is unaffected.
